'''House Arawn''' is an ancient [[House]], one of the nineteen strong Houses of [[Andor]]. Its [[High Seat]] is [[Naean Arawn]]. [[File:Arawn.png|alt=Triple silver keys on a background of blue.|thumb|Sign of House Arawn]]

== House sigil ==

Arawn's sigil consists of three silver keys, called The Triple Keys, on a blue background.{{ref/book|6|1}}{{ref/book|11|33}}

==Activities==

House Arawn supports [[Arymilla Marne|Arymilla's]] claim for the [[Lion Throne]] and participate in the attack on [[Caemlyn]]. Their forces are defeated and the rebel nobles, including Naean Arawn, are taken prisoners.{{ref/book|11|35}} House Arawn is thus ruined.
